g.text: Market Desk | persisted data through J08
Required product FKs: list item, saved entry, reminder, tracking.
Quantity 1..999; exact products are never merged.
Observation requires a tracking FK; alert tracking FK is optional.
Only one enabled period per product / retailer; re-enable starts a new period.
Unique: list name; (list, product); (product, retailer listing).
Retain observations for 90 days; retain deduplication state across pruning.
Unique alert: (tracking period, observationId, type), when ID is present.
LIVE imports only; unchanged prices add no history; unknowns break comparisons.
Summary date is unique; observationId may be null on a target event.
Armed target state and period locking prevent repeats without an observation ID.
Prices and limits: DECIMAL(19,4); optional values shown above.
Target rearms above limit; drops need adjacent known observations in one period.
Retailer-code preferences and observationId have no FK.
Null preference means Automatic lowest; explicit missing price stays unknown.
Embedded language columns are nullable; no LocalizedLabel table.
Import requires five product labels in all three languages; offers may be blank.
PK identifies each settings record and accepted import.
Settings / metadata use ID 1; no account or purchase ledger exists.
Diamonds show JPA-owned children or embedded values.
Observation time is retrieval time; a source price date is not supplied.
